project_title: Murray Bridge Games Group - PWA Community & Membership Platform
design_archetype: Neon Arcade & Tactical Club (Red/Blue Dual-Glow with Orange Energy Highlights)

brand_assets.widescreen_usage: Featured prominently at the top of every page header/navigation (neon night-scene banner with red-left, blue-right painted border)
brand_assets.round_usage: Used in mobile top bar badge, profile avatars default, favicon, footer, check-in dialog, and compact headers
brand_assets.soloverse_usage: Featured game tile with rainbow hexagon logo badge

favourite_games_rail.desktop_behavior: Fixed side rails on left and right margins that stay stationary during vertical scroll. Randomizes order/featured set on every page load.
favourite_games_rail.mobile_behavior: Horizontal scrolling marquee / ribbon ticker at top/bottom of content or collapsible drawer to preserve touch screen real estate.
favourite_games_rail.tile_style: Stylised typographic & iconic badges with custom neon borders, glowing genre chips, hover scale, and Soloverse rainbow hexagon emblem.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase
scale.caption: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-mono

layout_and_grid.bento_grid_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8
layout_and_grid.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
layout_and_grid.spacing_philosophy: Generous vertical rhythm with py-16 to py-24 between major landing sections and p-6 on internal containers

landing_hero_and_membership_offer.headline: Murray Bridge Games Group
landing_hero_and_membership_offer.subtitle: Board games, card games, computer games & community in SA
landing_hero_and_membership_offer.annual_sub_offer: $120 AUD / Year (Save $50 AUD vs $170/yr standard $5 door fee). Disclaimer: No further discount if sessions missed.
benefits: Free drink & snack during free admission sessions
1 guaranteed game choice per month (host notification token)
3-month raffle prize holding window without requiring attendance

digital_checkin_and_pay.admission_fee: $5 AUD single session check-in auto-paid via Square or free for active $120/yr subscribers
digital_checkin_and_pay.attendance_tracker: Option to check in digitally on website/PWA to log total sessions attended vs subscription savings

monthly_game_choice_token.function: Subscribers get 1 token per month to select guaranteed table/computer game.
monthly_game_choice_token.host_alert: Triggers host notification alert in Admin Panel with user ID & chosen game name.

honor_system_game_log.tabs: Separate tab per game with filtered game log tables

raffle_and_donations.raffle: Buy lucky-number raffle entries for end-of-year free session celebration
raffle_and_donations.donations: Preset tiers: $5, $10, $20, $50, or custom AUD donation via Square

public_profiles.user_stats_summary: Total games logged, favorite game, subscriber badge

features: View incoming game choice token alerts with chosen game & timestamp

component_guidelines.interactive_elements: Must use custom Tailwind styling with high contrast text and hover glows
component_guidelines.toasts: Use sonner for notifications (e.g., token spent, check-in confirmed, game logged)
component_guidelines.pwa_compatibility: Service worker manifest, add-to-homescreen prompt, touch-optimized hit areas (min 44px)

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Javascript React (.js) files are used with Tailwind CSS and standard Lucide / Radix icons.
Feature widescreen logo /brand/wide.png at top header across pages with red-left blue-right neon border theme.
Feature round logo /brand/round.png for mobile badges, user avatars, dialogs, and footers.
Implement fixed side game rails featuring random mixes from the 20 favourite games on each page load.
Support Square hosted checkout flows or mock Square payment dialogs with clear AUD pricing.
Maintain strict high-contrast dark theme with red (#FF3B5C), blue (#00E5FF), and orange (#FF8C00) accents.
Attach data-testid to every button, tab, input, and critical metric for automated verification.
